anti_false_edges.reason: flattened isotope vs helium-trimer ambiguity; require domain
three carbon atoms vs one C atom triply ionized
trioxidane formula not density anomaly of ordinary H2O
two scattering/correlation peaks ≠ same physical acoustic origin
instrument/sky latent separation does not expose hidden transformer attention tensors
primordial 3He/4He isotope ratio and 4He mass fraction are different quantities
H3+ ion charge must not be dropped
same large scale physics in principle but tracer biases, z bins, covariance and foregrounds must be controlled

invariant_of_invariants.identity: canonical form + isotope + electric charge + stoichiometry must survive text transformations
invariant_of_invariants.dimensions: all units must match every mechanistic edge and observational likelihood
invariant_of_invariants.scale: quantum/atomic, molecular, instrumental, astrophysical and cosmological context do not collapse
invariant_of_invariants.source: every edge has literature source, status, gate and explicit negative test
invariant_of_invariants.statistical: do not compare fits with incommensurate redshifts, selection, foregrounds or covariance
invariant_of_invariants.reversibility: derive typed reference from raw token without deleting raw Unicode
invariant_of_invariants.heads: only visible model outputs are observable; hidden attention weights/activations TOKEN_VAZIO_NOT_ACCESSIBLE
invariant_of_invariants.null: unknown/ambiguous/contradictory is different from zero or a negative measurement
invariant_of_invariants.promotion: only causal model with units, falsifier, data and independent receipt can become scientific claim
invariant_of_invariants.model: RLL not validated and original global WS01 distance tolerance must not be relaxed

priority_policy: Heuristic priority by independently observed physical mapping, falsifiability, uncertainty reduction, cost, and avoidance of circular data reuse; not an empirical entropy measurement.
